ex.en: Getting home will take you at the very least an hour.
ex.ja: 家に帰るには最低一時間かかる。

en: In the distant past; especially, at a time fondly remembered (the good old days).

ex.en: Back in the day, we didn't have smartphones.
ex.ja: 昔はスマートフォンなんてなかった。

en: To obstruct.
To book, set aside (an unbroken period of time to do an activity).

ex.en: The police have blocked off the area.
ex.ja: 警察はそのエリアを封鎖した。

ex.en: The air was blocked off, extinguishing the fire.
ex.ja: 空気を遮断して火を消した。

ex.en: I'll kill you! Knock your block off and grind you underfoot! You shithead! Die!
ex.ja: 殺してやる！ぶっ殺して、踏み潰してやる！くそったれ！死ね！

en: To buy the whole of; to purchase the entire stock of something.
To buy whatever is available of something.

ex.en: He was bought up by his strong willed sister.
ex.ja: 彼は男まさりの姉に育てられた。

ex.en: The big investor bought up the stocks.
ex.ja: 大投資かは株を買い占めた。

en: Mostly; generally; all things considered.
Sailing alternately into the wind and in the same direction as the wind.

ex.en: By and large, your idea is a good one.
ex.ja: 全体的にみると、君の考えはよろしい。

ex.en: By and large, women can bear pain better than men.
ex.ja: 概して、女は男より苦痛に耐え得るものだ。

ex.en: We've been fine, by and large.
ex.ja: 全体的にはうまくやっています。

en: To become cloudy or overcast.

ex.en: Look at the cloud over there.
ex.ja: ずっと向こうの雲を見てごらん。

ex.en: There were black clouds over our heads.
ex.ja: 私たちの頭の上には黒雲があった。

ex.en: The sky clouded over.
ex.ja: 空は一面にくもった。

en: A sudden and complete withdrawal from a dependent substance, especially a drug.
The physiological effects of such a withdrawal.
Not gradually; all at once; referring especially to quitting a habit by force of will rather than by a gradual reduction.
To undergo sudden and complete withdrawal from a dependent substance, especially a drug.

ex.en: Maybe, but he wants me to stop cold turkey.
ex.ja: たぶんね。だけど、今すぐにやめなさいだって。

ex.en: He quit smoking cold turkey.
ex.ja: 彼は煙草をきっぱりとやめた。

en: Totally fairly and undoubtedly.
Within the applicable rules.
Unquestionably fair.

ex.en: We won the game fair and square.
ex.ja: 私たちは正々堂々と試合に勝った。

en: To play a card of the same suit as the previous or leading card.
To follow an example; to imitate or copy the actions of another.

ex.en: When one store lowered its prices, the others had to follow suit.
ex.ja: ある店が値下げすると、ほかの店もそれにならわざるを得なかった。

en: Expressing complete satisfaction with someone's efforts.
The maximum marks obtainable in an exam or test.
Complete approval or agreement.

ex.en: That student actually got full marks in English.
ex.ja: あの学生が英語で満点を取ったんだよ。

ex.en: The teacher gave me full marks for math.
ex.ja: 先生は私の数学に満点をくれた。

ex.en: He got full marks in English.
ex.ja: 彼は英語で満点を取った。

en: Brown with golden highlights.
A yellowish orangey color; a brown color with a golden tinge.

ex.en: Fry the potatoes until they are golden brown.
ex.ja: ジャガイモをきつね色になるまで揚げてください。

en: Remaining hidden (typically of a person).

ex.en: He has become expert in hiding his true feeling.
ex.ja: 彼は本心を隠すのが上手くなった。

en: To hold hands (to clasp each other's hands).
To work together to achieve a common goal.

ex.en: The children join hands and form a circle.
ex.ja: 子どもたちは手をつないで輪になる。

en: A dark blue color.
Having a navy blue color.

ex.en: Mary was wearing a navy blue dress.
ex.ja: メアリーは紺色のドレスを身にまとっていた。

ex.en: I'm looking for a navy blue raincoat, size 36.
ex.ja: ネービーブルーのレインコートを探しているんですよ、サイズは３６なんだけど。

ex.en: Mary was wearing a navy blue skirt.
ex.ja: メアリーはネービーブルーのスカートをはいていた。

en: To attach or secure with pins.
To identify something (e.g. a decision or plan) clearly or specifically.

ex.en: He was pinned down by a fallen tree.
ex.ja: 彼は倒れた木の下敷きになってうごけなかった。

ex.en: Investigators are trying to pin down the cause of today's fire.
ex.ja: 鑑識班は今日の火事の原因を特定しようとしている。

en: The period from the about the time of the launch of Sputnik in 1957 to the present day, during which people ventured into space.
Redolent of the space age; appearing futuristic or modern.

ex.en: I had to write a paper on the Space Age last weekend.
ex.ja: 先週末は宇宙時代についてのレポートを書かなければならなかった。

en: Indicates that the telephone line is busy.

ex.en: The line is busy now. Please hold the line.
ex.ja: ただいま話し中ですので、電話を切らずにお待ち下さい。

ex.en: Sorry, the line is busy now.
ex.ja: すみません。ただいま話し中です。

ex.en: I'm afraid the line is busy.
ex.ja: あいにく話中です。

en: Believing or making assumptions, often incorrectly.

ex.en: Some were under the impression that the judges had not chosen wisely.
ex.ja: 審査員の選択は賢明でなかったと思う人もいました。

en: Without causing or experiencing difficulty; not encountering any impediments.

ex.en: The festival ended without incident.
ex.ja: 祭りは何事もなく終わった。

en: Worse or lower than average.

ex.en: Your marks were well below average this term.
ex.ja: 君の成績は今学期は平均よりだいぶ下だった。

ex.en: Your work is below average.
ex.ja: 君の仕事は平均以下だ。

ex.en: His work is below average.
ex.ja: 彼の仕事は標準以下だ。

en: A flight recorder; the brightly colored cockpit voice recorders and flight data recorders in an aircraft designed to aid in determining t…
Any similar device on motor vehicles, such as rail event recorders and ship trip recorders.
To focus on the inputs and outputs without worrying about the internal complexity.

ex.en: There is much sugar in this black box.
ex.ja: この黒い箱に砂糖がたくさんある。

ex.en: What's in the black box?
ex.ja: 黒い箱には何が入ってるの？

en: No matter what the future may hold (no matter whether it is good or bad).

ex.en: For better or worse, she will have the operation tomorrow.
ex.ja: なにがなんでも、彼女は明日手術を受けるでしょう。

ex.en: For better or worse anyone is able to do it.
ex.ja: 良くも悪くも誰でもできる。

en: Desperately.

ex.en: She held on to it for dear life.
ex.ja: 彼女はそれを後生大事にとっておいた。

ex.en: He ran away for dear life.
ex.ja: 彼は命からがらにげさった。

ex.en: She ran for dear life.
ex.ja: 彼女は必死になって走った。

en: In oestrus; receptive to mating.

ex.en: A female cat in heat can be very noisy.
ex.ja: 発情期の雌猫はとてもうるさくなることがある。

en: In the form of goods and services rather than money.
With goods or services (as opposed to cash).
In a reciprocal manner; in a similar way; in the same kind.

ex.en: They are different in degree but not in kind.
ex.ja: それらは程度の差で本質的には違いはない。

ex.en: They paid me in kind.
ex.ja: 彼らは私に現物支給でくれたよ。

en: To open one's mouth wide, to gape.
Used other than figuratively or idiomatically: see open, wide.

ex.en: I'll feed it to you so ... here, open wide.
ex.ja: わたしが食べさせますから・・・はい、アーンして。

ex.en: An eyelid opens wide.
ex.ja: 瞼が大きく開く。

en: To raise (put at a higher level)

ex.en: Raise up your left hand.
ex.ja: 左手を上げなさい。

en: To recite a prayer of invocation or thanksgiving at meal time.

ex.en: He said grace before eating.
ex.ja: 彼は食べる前にお祈りを言った。

en: To cause to begin to burn.
To arouse passionate feelings in.

ex.en: The hut was set on fire.
ex.ja: その小屋に火がつけられた。

en: To seem logical, rational, or reasonable; to make sense.

ex.en: It stands to reason that workers are paid.
ex.ja: 労働者が給料をもらうのは当然だ。

ex.en: It stands to reason that I should decline the offer.
ex.ja: 私がその申し出を断るのは当然だ。

ex.en: It stands to reason that nobody likes him. He's too mean.
ex.ja: 彼を好きな人がいないのは当然だ。本当に卑劣な奴だから。

en: To be courageous; to regain one's courage.
Used when encouraging someone to bear or take up a difficult situation.

ex.en: We hope she will take heart soon.
ex.ja: 彼女がすぐに元気になるといいのだが。

ex.en: Take heart and do it again.
ex.ja: 気をとりなおしてもう一度やってごらん。

en: Inexperienced; just beginning; immature (especially in judgment).

ex.en: Luciano might have the crowd behind him, but he's still wet behind the ears.
ex.ja: ルチアーノは大声援を背負って戦えるかもしれないが、彼はまだヒヨコに過ぎない。

en: To urinate in one's bed (during sleep).
To go bad, to fail. Often said of machines; a euphemism for shit the bed.

ex.en: Don't tell anyone that I wet the bed.
ex.ja: おねしょしたことはみんなに内緒にしてくれ！

ex.en: I wet the bed until I was ten years old.
ex.ja: 私は１０歳までおねしょをしていた。

ex.en: After Tom's family moved to Australia, he started wetting the bed again.
ex.ja: トムの家族がオーストラリアに移住した後、彼はまたおねしょし始めた。

zh: 冒昧地說一下 /冒昧地说一下

en: A phrase used before disagreeing with someone or saying something they may find offensive, usually considered polite.

ex.en: With all due respect.
ex.ja: お言葉ですが......。

en: Having the joy and vitality associated with younger people, despite one's own advanced age.

ex.en: He is young at heart.
ex.ja: 彼は気持ちが若い。

en: With everything included, counted, or summed; in total.

ex.en: We need twenty eggs all told.
ex.ja: 全部で20個の卵が必要です。

ex.en: The members numbered thirty, all told.
ex.ja: 会員は全部で３０名だった。

en: To extend or lengthen excessively; to draw out.
To haul or bring out forcefully or from an awkward location.

ex.en: The lawyers tried to drag out the trial.
ex.ja: 弁護士たちは裁判を長引かせようとした。

en: A message signaling that the game has ended, usually because the player failed (for example by losing all of their lives) but sometimes f…
The end of some ongoing situation, especially in failure.
An appearance of a game over message.

ex.en: Having lost the game over and over again, he finally gave in.
ex.ja: 何度も何度も負けたあとで、ついに彼は降参した。

ex.en: She chatted with her friends about the football game over coffee.
ex.ja: 彼女はコーヒーを飲みながらフットボールの試合について友人と歓談した。

en: Used other than figuratively or idiomatically: see get, wrong.
To be told off or reprimanded; to get into trouble.

ex.en: What exactly did I get wrong?
ex.ja: 私は具体的に何を間違えたの？

en: To accidentally encounter a person or situation; to chance upon, happen on or stumble across.

ex.en: I happened upon Bernard at a restaurant yesterday.
ex.ja: きのうある料理店で、私は突然、バーナードにあった。

en: To enjoy oneself thoroughly; to have lots of fun or excitement.

ex.en: I have a ball-point pen, but I want another.
ex.ja: ボールペンを１本持っているが、もう１本ほしい。

ex.en: I had a ball.
ex.ja: とても楽しかったです。

en: To hunt something and capture or kill it.
To destroy by persecution or violence.

ex.en: The police will hunt down the escaped prisoner.
ex.ja: 警察は脱走した囚人を追い詰めるだろう。

en: More than.

ex.en: Never spend in excess of your income.
ex.ja: 収入を超過して支出をするな。

ex.en: The load of the truck was in excess of three tons.
ex.ja: そのトラックの積み荷は三トンを超えていた。

en: An unexpected change from the way things seemed to be going.
Used other than figuratively or idiomatically: see left, turn.
A command to a soldier or other person who is marching: turn ninety degrees to your left!
To turn ninety degrees to one's left, especially in response to a military command while marching.

ex.en: Drive to the next intersection and make a left turn.
ex.ja: 次の交差点まで行って左折しなさい。

ja: 光あれ（聖書の創世記の言葉）

en: Used as a metaphor for the spread of wisdom.

ex.en: And God said: Let there be light. And there was light.
ex.ja: 神光あれと言給ひければ光ありき。

ex.en: Let there be light!
ex.ja: 光あれ！

en: Used to add emphasis to the fact that the story takes place in the distant past.

ex.en: Long long ago, there lived a pretty girl.
ex.ja: 昔々かわいい少女が住んでいました。

ex.en: Long, long ago, there lived an old man in a village.
ex.ja: 昔々ある村にひとりの老人が住んでいた。

ex.en: Long, long ago, there lived an old man and his wife.
ex.ja: 昔々おじいさんとおばあさんが住んでいました。

en: To become a part of (a family or its property, heritage, memberships, etc.), by marrying a member of it.

ex.en: She is going to marry into a wealthy family.
ex.ja: 彼女は裕福な家に嫁ぐことになっている。

ja: 私の目の黒いうちはだめだ

en: Under no circumstances; absolutely not.

ex.en: Over my dead body.
ex.ja: 絶対にダメだ。

en: A dollhouse.
A child's toy domestic dwelling, large enough for the child to enter.
To pretend to be a family in the household, acting out housekeeping and different family roles.
To live as if married without actually being legally married, cohabit

ex.en: We often played house in the park.
ex.ja: 私たちは公園でよくままごとをしたものだ。

en: Any government and all entities that are controlled or funded by it.
Of or relating to a public sector.

ex.en: He has worked in the public sector for twenty years.
ex.ja: 彼は２０年間、公共部門で働いてきた。

en: To connect (a telephone caller) with the callee.
to cause to endure
A transaction by a broker outside the stock exchange, bringing a buyer and seller together.

ex.en: The new model car was put through several tests.
ex.ja: その新型車は何度か厳しいテストを受けた。

ex.en: He was put through university with money left by his uncle.
ex.ja: 彼は叔父の残したお金で大学を卒業した。

en: To cause (someone) to sleep.
To help (someone) to bed.

ex.en: This medicine can put to sleep even the most nervous patients.
ex.ja: この薬はとても緊張している患者でも眠らせることができる。

en: To deceive someone.
To drive (a person) to a remote location in order to murder them.

ex.en: I was taken for a ride.
ex.ja: 私はいっぱい食わされた。

en: To reverse a situation, usually so that the advantage has shifted to the party which was previously disadvantaged.

ex.en: The team managed to turn the tables in the second half.
ex.ja: そのチームは後半に形勢を逆転させた。

zh: 請嫁給我好嗎？ /请嫁给我好吗？
ja: 結婚してくれませんか

en: Used to propose marriage to someone

ex.en: Will you marry me?
ex.ja: 僕と結婚してくれますか。
